title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.53: Card-selection prompts (Run Through, Workshop, Practice, etc.) now state the amount - e.g. 'Choose 2 cards to make Tuned' - and require you to pick exactly that many: the confirm button stays disabled until the full amount is selected, like base-game discard cards. When only that many (or fewer) eligible cards exist, they are applied automatically with no prompt.
